ns2:section.sectionText: Course title: Online Reputation Management and Brand Promotion. This course will introduce students to digital and web-based communication strategies and tactics that organizations use to manage their reputations and to promote their brands. Some topics to be covered include: responding to social media threats to an organization's reputation; digital engagment metrics; managing an organization's social media presence. *Eligible for PR minor as advanced topic coursework: https://media.illinois.edu/pr_minor
